scope: SIGGRAPH 2026 Technical Papers, including selected TOG presentations; author-released trained weights, LoRAs, policies, and bundled networks. SIGGRAPH Asia, posters, courses, API-only systems, code-only releases, and methods using only unrelated upstream weights are excluded.
